column1: # What real geometry does, frozen: `name SMILES i j path min max`.
# `path` is 1 for a bond and 2 for a 1-3 pair; `min` and `max` are the range
# that pair covers over MMFF-relaxed ETKDGv3 conformers (seed 20261009, six
# each, validated the way tests/bounds_quality.py validates them -- nothing
# outside 50 kcal/mol of the best, nothing with a bond past 1.25x its
# covalent radii). Indices are RDKit's, which match ours for heavy atoms
# because both read the same SMILES.
# This exists so `cargo test` can check the distance bounds against reality
# rather than against nothing. Our 1-2 centre carries three fitted constants
# coefficient -- calibrated against exactly this kind of geometry, and
# nothing in the suite would otherwise notice if a change to the relaxation
# or to MMFF's parameters quietly invalidated them.
# The molecule list is deliberately rich in crowded and strained bonds,
# because those are what the constants are for and therefore what a guard
# has to be able to see. Regenerate with scratchpad/make_fixture.py only
# when the reference itself should move, and say why in the commit.
